claim_boundary: EOS-Bench supplies orbital and observation fields. All ground-service windows, link rates, releases, deadlines, and delivery outcomes in this audit are simulated, not measured and not supplied by EOS-Bench.

source.license_status: No license file or Hugging Face license tag was present in the locally archived metadata; do not redistribute source inputs without permission.

mapping.payload_rule: maximum positive EOS sensor data_rate_Mbps in the source scenario times mission duration_s divided by 8000 to obtain decimal GB; this keeps missions with no opportunity in the denominator
mapping.observation_rule: use only provider windows that reference known missions, satellites, and sensors and that can contain the required duration
mapping.isl_rule: no ISL because the audited source files supply none

simulated_ground_service_overlay.sharing_rule: Every satellite receives the same periodic service opportunity; the single shared ground-station resource can serve only one reserved window at a time.
simulated_ground_service_overlay.geometry_claim: The overlay is a controlled service schedule, not a propagated visibility calculation and not an operational contact trace.

policies.weight_provenance: candidate 6 was selected without held-out feedback in three of four original fleet-size folds; equal weights were the fourth-fold selection. Both are frozen before this audit and neither is selected from EOS-Bench outcomes.

statistics.independent_unit: source scenario JSON after averaging random seeds within scenario
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction over primary RACS-vs-comparator completion tests
statistics.scope_warning: The 24 files include related scenario families; inference is exploratory and must not be described as 24 independent operational campaigns.
